_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: classical (hellenic/greek) lean + east_asian (japonic) substrate (cross-family fusion, Hellenic-leaning)
homeland: Wahellas (the Isle-Hellas; the shrine-isles and the poleis of the inner sea)

blend.lean_parent: classical (hellenic/greek, achillean register: the polis city-states, the -os/-on/-eus endings, the aspirates th/ph/kh, the patronymic -ides, the agora and the temenos, penultimate stress, the Tulrios/Orlandros canon-morphs)
blend.substrate_parent: east_asian (japonic, yamataian register: the open CV-mora shrine-isles and castle-towns, the kami of mountain and sea, the rice-and-silk-and-jade staple words, the torii-shrine, the daimyo house and the -no- linking particle)
blend.lean: Hellenic-heavy (Greek) - a single fused people of the inner-sea isles, where the polis of the philosopher and the shrine-isle of the monk grew into one tongue and one rite: the olive and the cherry on one slope, the agora before the torii. The Hellenic polis/civic/learned register is the backbone; the Japonic island/shrine/material/staple words are the substrate. Not a ruling elite over a populace - one merged people, one fused language (per gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md).

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_07 (Greek, Achillean register) x BASE_08 (Japonic, Yamataian register). FUSION-FIRST (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): a SINGLE fused tongue, one word per concept, derived by principled sound-change from both parents - not a slash-pair dual-register gloss. CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Greek (Classical) base = Civilized, Japonic base = Clanhold, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Wahellas is Civilized (feudal). Concept: the polis and the shrine-isle as one - the philosopher and the monk, the olive and the cherry, the agora and the torii - the Hellenic city-states of the inner sea grown together with the kami-shrines of the island-arc into a single rite over a sea-strewn isle-realm ('Wa' + 'Hellas', the harmony-Hellas / isle-Hellas). Lean = Hellenic (the rule/kin/civic/learned/land register, the -os/-on/-eus endings, the patronymic -ides, the agora/temenos, penultimate stress); substrate = Japonic (island, shrine, mountain, sea, rice, silk, jade, the castle-town - the land, material and staple words). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Greek register (allowed, catalog 5.3), with the Japonic substrate words fused into Hellenic phonology; DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Hellenic canon-morphs PRIMARY (the achillean column: Tulrios, Orlandros, Numenos, Gaiandros, Realtia, Aiternos), Japonic kami-morphs SECONDARY (the yamataian / family_east_asian.json japonic column, softened to Hellenic shape), never real Greek gods or Shinto kami. All three alignments (per 2026-06-27: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are ENGLISH except the county which uses the approved commonly-known term 'Archon' (the city-magistrate, the Hellenic civic-lord) and the duchy which uses 'Daimyo' (the great island-house lord, the apt Japonic-substrate co-rank); conlang titles in ruler_native/domain_native (Hellenic) for NPC dialogue. CSV phonetic profile 'Soft consonants with pitch accent'; grammar 'SOV, Honorific complex aspects'.

phonology.palette: Classical (Hellenic) lean - aspirates th/ph/kh, the liquids l/r, sibilant s, stops p t k b d g, vowel-rich a e i o u with long e/o, -os/-on/-es/-eus endings, penultimate stress, the patronymic -id- - taking up an East-Asian (Japonic) substrate: open CV moras, the five vowels a i u e o, the island/shrine/mountain/sea/rice/silk/jade word-stock, rendaku voicing, pitch accent. Per the CSV: soft consonants with pitch accent (the Japonic CV gentleness and pitch-rise audible beneath the Hellenic aspirate-and-liquid softening and the open -os/-on closes); grammar is SOV with honorific complex aspects (the Japonic verb-final order and the honorific kami-suffixes reshaped into a Hellenic morphology of -os/-on/-eus closes and aspectual particles). Theophoric on the Hellenic canon-morphs (Tulrio-, Orlandro-) with the Japonic kami-morphs as the shrine register (Terashio-, Haganos-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; Hellenic onset clusters (st, tr, pr, kl, sp, ph, th, kh, ps) meeting Japonic CV-moras that shed or soften their final vowel into a Hellenic -os/-on/-e/-eus close or open vowel-final; Japonic -no/-yama/-shima/-mori elements take Hellenic endings (yama>oramos, shima>nesimos, mori>morion); penultimate stress overrides Japonic pitch-accent; -polis/-eia/-os toponyms over -nesos/-shima island-and-shrine elements.

sound_changes: Japonic open CV-moras adapt to Hellenic shape: the final open vowel is kept vowel-final or recut to a Hellenic -os/-on/-e/-eus close; very short Japonic roots take a Hellenic -os/-on ending (yama>oramos, shima>nesimos, mori>morion, umi>thalimi, kawa>potamo)

Japonic plain consonants soften toward the Hellenic inventory: k>k/kh, t>t/th, s>s/sh-to-s, voiced g/d/b retained; Japonic has no l, so l is moot and r is kept; geminates resolved into Hellenic single stops or clusters

Japonic pitch-accent is overridden by Hellenic penultimate stress; word order stays Japonic-substrate SOV but is dressed in Hellenic case-endings; the Japonic -no linking particle is kept honorifically but reshaped (X-no-Y > X-on- / -o-)

retain the Hellenic aspirates th/ph/kh, the -os/-on/-eus closes and the patronymic -ides, and the audible Japonic -shima/-yama/-mori/-shio island-and-shrine signatures softened into Hellenic finals; the seam is welded so the two ancestries both stay heard
fusion_rules.source_tilt: rule / kin-line / civic / learned / land-feature / quality / abstract / war words from Hellenic roots (the polis register: potamos, oros, polis, hieros, sideros, megas); island / shrine / material / staple words from Japonic roots, softened to Hellenic shape (the substrate: nesimos<shima, shrines, kome<rice, kinu<silk, hisui<jade); every chosen root then run through one Hellenic-shaped sound-law so the split is invisible at the surface

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Hellenic rule/kin/civic/learned/land-roots + Japonic island/shrine/material/staple-roots, all run through one Hellenic-shaped sound-law; portmanteaus mark the blended institutions, the shrine-isle, and the bloodline. NO slash-pair dual-register forms - one word per concept.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Hellenic patronymic -ides / -ades (son of) fuses with the Japonic clan-first order and the -no- linking particle (oikos no X, X-ides); the noble house keeps an oikos-name (-ke softened to -oie); names given at the coming-of-age rite.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word with Hellenic linking -o-, the Japonic element fused into the tail: melas + oramos -> Melanoramos (black-mountain), Nea + Polis -> Neapolis, Shi- + temenjia -> Hieratemenjia (sacred shrine-town); rendaku-style softening at the seam.

title_ladder.government: feudal (an isle-Hellenic monarchy of the inner sea: the basileus at Wahellas over the strategos-dukes and the city-archons; the polis-council and the shrine-elders advise, the daimyo-houses of the great isles rule their precincts, the brotherhood of the philosopher and the monk orders the realm)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Hellenic-lean ladder, ascending, with the Japonic substrate fused into the domain-tails. Toparchos (place-ruler) barony; Phrourarchos (garrison-warden) march; Eparchos (city-magistrate, shown as the approved 'Archon') county; Strategos (general-governor, shown as the approved 'Daimyo' - the great island-house lord) duchy; Dynastes (prince-ruler) principality; Basileus (king) kingdom over a Basilei-tenka (the realm-under-heaven, the Japonic tenka fused on); Autokrator (self-ruler) empire over the Autokrat-enka. The polis-council (boule), the shrine-elders and the daimyo-houses order the realm beneath the crown. (Rank titles fuse the real Greek register with the Japonic substrate, allowed; Archon and Daimyo are the approved commonly-known display terms.)

vassalage.vassal: Symmakerai (sworn ally-retainer; Hellenic symmachos + Japonic kerai)
vassalage.fealty: Horkchugi (the oath-loyalty; Hellenic horkos + Japonic chugi)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - Archon for the county, Daimyo for the duchy). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the oikos (house/clan) name fuses with the Hellenic personal-first habit and the Japonic clan-first order; commonly personal + patronymic (-ides) + oikos/isle-demonym, or oikos no X for the high-born; an honor-name taken at the coming-of-age rite.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the renowned carry an oikos and an honor-name and a descriptive epithet (ho Megas); commoners a single name + isle-demonym or trade-name.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the canon-morphs + a fused element: Tulrio-/Numeno- (Hellenic devotion), -maru (child/blade), Terashi-/Take- (the shrine-kami register): e.g. Tulriokles, Terashimaru, names honoring Orlandros and Terashio-no-kami.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Hellenic canon-morphs PRIMARY (the achillean column: Tulrios, Orlandros, Numenos, Gaiandros, Realtia, softened through Hellenic -os/-on/-eus and th/ph/kh), Japonic kami-morphs SECONDARY (the yamataian / family_east_asian.json japonic column: Terashi-no-kami, Hagane-no-kami, Iwane-no-kami, softened to Hellenic shape), never real Greek gods or Shinto kami. Wahellas seeds/shifts across all three alignments; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met at the temenos and the torii-shrine of the isle; the hierophant-and-kannushi (fused philosopher-priest and shrine-keeper) mediate, and the honored ancestral dead are kept at the household heroon and the clan-jinja.
religion.the_one: Aiternos (< Aeternus; Hellenic Aiternos, Japonic kami-face Takami-no-kami) - the One, the unknowable source, the High-Heaven distant above the myriad powers; honored not petitioned, revered when Lawful, set aside when Chaotic

Tulrius.gloss: the sun and just rule; Lawful power

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiternos) and the Lawful powers - Tulrios the just, Orlandros of the sworn war, Gaiandros the enduring, Realtia the merciful - at the temenos and the sun-shrine; the philosopher's law and the warrior's honor-code bind alike, and the Chaotic powers are named the kakodaimones (evil spirits) and warded.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: honors the ancestral dead (the heroes of the oikos, the eirei of the clan-jinja) and the local powers of hearth, isle, grove and sea; the great powers of the canon are invoked situationally at the temenos and the torii rather than worshipped whole.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the war-flame and the wild storm-kami of the untamed isles - and names the Lawful powers, and the One, as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment) keep their morphs + a dread epithet, distinct per power: when Lawful - Maraxus -> Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame (Japonic Takebios the War-Fury), Vacidus -> Vakidos the Unmaker (Japonic Utsuros the Devouring Void), Lusanto -> Lusantos the Hoard-Serpent (Japonic Koganorochi); when Chaotic - Tulrius -> Tulrios the Cold-Light, Aeternus -> Aiternos the Far Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Temenjia (temple-and-shrine precinct) of [power] on the isle: 'the Temenjia of Tulrios', within its torii-gate and sacred olive-and-cherry grove.
religion.saints_pattern: the Heros-kami (the deified heroes and grove-and-sea spirits) and the great ancestors of the oikos, enshrined as kami at the heroon and the clan-jinja of the holy isle; 'the Heros [name]' / 'the kami [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tulrios: a radiate sun-disc above an olive-branch, a mirror and the scales
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlandros: an iron spear crossed before a torii and an oath-ring
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaiandros: a mist-wreathed grey peak over an olive-terrace and a torii

banks_patterns.ships: war-galleys and shrine-junks of the inner sea, feminine -is and isle-virtue names: 'the Nesimos', 'the Wave-Crane', 'Pride of Wahellas', 'Hagane-nesos'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [Adjective] Phalanx / the [color] Sonae (battle-formation): 'the Bronze Phalanx', 'the Crimson Sonae', 'the Olive-and-Cherry Lochos'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Amber Kylix', 'The Floating Olive', 'The Cherry Teahouse'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: sunken poleis and abandoned isle-shrines: 'the drowned Akroshiro of [oikos]', 'the haunted Temenjia of [name]', 'the Labyrinth of Heros Theron'
